Filing Income Tax Return (ITR) online as a salaried employee in India is straightforward and can be done through the official income tax portal of India, known as the Income Tax Department's e-filing website. Here’s a step-by-step guide to help you file your ITR:

### Step 1: Gather Required Documents
Before you start filing, ensure that you have all the necessary documents:
- PAN Card (Permanent Account Number)
- Salary slips for the financial year (April 1 - March 31)
- Details of any other income sources like interest from savings accounts, fixed deposits, etc.
- Details of deductions under Section 80C, 80D, etc., if applicable
- Any tax-saving investments made during the financial year
